description: Stage 4 / CODEX P0.1: proves the discard bug is not ability-only -- a TraitsConfig-side beforeTurn skip (sword_charm: one-shot +4 Atk, 'skip turn', bundle.deobfuscated.js buildTraitsConfig BT block) is ALSO a generic hook, so it's discarded the same way once merged with the (always-built, for gen3/4) Gen3AbilityConfig. Just picking sword_charm as the only passive already forces the merge (ability_config is unconditional in gen3/4; traits_config becomes non-null as soon as passives is non-empty) -- no separate ability needs to be relevant on this species.
